variants.optimizerInput: Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. Create ONE compact freestanding roller-skate rack, no taller than it is wide, with four obvious open cubbies. In the two lower cubbies place EXACTLY ONE matching pair of QUAD ROLLER SKATES. Each skate must visibly have a boot upper, two trucks/axles and FOUR large round wheels. Leave upper cubbies empty so the rack structure reads clearly. Warm oak + botanical green accents, small leaf detail, plain studio background. NO sneakers, NO ice skates, NO soccer cleats, NO boards, NO second rack, NO plants dominating, NO text.

Skate Rack, Room Decor, Tier 3, Garden Glow. One low wide cubby rack with exactly two recognizable quad roller skates stored side by side, each with four visible wheels and boot silhouette. Empty upper bays, stable base, restrained green/wood theme. NO ordinary shoes, NO single shoe, NO multiple racks, NO wall shelving, NO room scene, NO text.

Dream Vanity Set, Room Decor, Tier 4, Art Attack. Create EXACTLY ONE freestanding vanity furniture set on a plain studio background: one compact vanity table with four visible legs/supports and two drawers, one large attached oval mirror centered above it, and exactly one matching padded stool placed directly in front. Use cream, lavender, coral and aqua paint-splash accents only on the furniture. Full set isolated and fully visible with grounded shadows. NO wall cabinetry, NO room architecture, NO built-in shelves, NO extra mirrors, NO multiple views, NO collage, NO text.

Trophy Wall, Room Decor, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Create ONE isolated wall-mounted trophy display: one dark navy rectangular backboard with gold trim, one shallow gold shelf, EXACTLY THREE large unmistakable trophy CUPS with handles sitting on the shelf, plus two hanging round medals beneath. The cups and medals must dominate the image and read clearly at Store-card size. Add only small star inlays. Plain wall plane and contact shadow. NO abstract shards, NO mosaic, NO room scene, NO shelves full of unrelated objects, NO text.
